summary: BifrOSt has a cached-thumbnail path and cache for apps (thumbnail_path, ThumbnailCache) and the image decoder and scaler a generator would need, but no generator for file types (images, text, PDF, audio, video) and no thumbnail-provider extension point for custom file types. The Quick Look panel that would show thumbnails is decoded by the shell and not drawn.

features.feature: Thumbnail generation for common file types
features.apple: QLThumbnailGenerator: images, Live Photos, text files, PDFs, audio and video files, USDZ (iOS and iPadOS only)
features.note: The thumbnails service draws text, image, audio/video (cover or waveform card), font, contact, calendar, web, archive (entry count) and clipping files; unknown types get the icon. No PDF, video poster frame or duration badge, no extension point for third-party providers. Needs a Midget check.

features.feature: Thumbnail request by size and scale (generateBestRepresentation)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/thumbnails.rs (request, reply, ThumbRequest and edge_px re-exported from bifrost_ui::thumb_service); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs
features.note: A request names a path, a size in points, a scale and a kind, and is validated (BadPath, BadSize); the answer (pending, pixels, icon or failed) decodes headless (thumbnail_edges_scale_and_clamp_to_the_pixel_limits, a_thumbnail_request_needs_an_absolute_clean_path_and_a_sane_size, thumbnail_answers_decode_into_their_states). There is no cache object and no completion or error callback in the SDK; the answer arrives as thumbnail ready or failed events. Verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Thumbnail representation types (icon, low quality, thumbnail)
features.note: The icon, low quality (a quarter of the edge, at least 16 px) and thumbnail tiers are chosen from the asked types with headless tests (an_empty_request_asks_for_every_tier_cheapest_first, a_request_gets_each_asked_tier_once_in_the_fixed_order). The service does not yet read the requested types from the request or draw per tier. Needs a Midget check.

Wave 2 (theme-35, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Single synchronous result per call. docs/bifrost-ui.md states the same gap.
Generated paths are remembered and purged under memory pressure, and a test covers the cache hit (peek.rs thumbnails_are_cached). The disk cache is the app's responsibility.

Wave 2 (theme-35, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No extension point lets an app register a thumbnail generator for another app's file type, and the system does not ask apps for thumbnails of their files.

features.feature: System-wide thumbnails in Files, Spotlight and other apps
features.apple: Finder and Spotlight display thumbnails from QLThumbnailGenerator and extensions
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/quicksearch.rs:19 (thumbnail_path on a searchable item), springboard/src/shell/today.rs:318 (Photos tile needs the thumbnail cache)
features.note: Searchable items store a thumbnail path, but the search panel does not draw it. Files shows only the picker preview from springboard/src/files/preview.rs:28 (preview_for), which picks an in-app preview kind, not a thumbnail.

features.feature: Quick Look panel showing thumbnails and previews
features.apple: QLPreviewPanel and QLPreviewItem (the preview panel is a separate Apple framework, linked from this page)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs (PreviewPanel, PreviewDataSource, ItemState); springboard/proto/src/peek.rs (ToShell::Preview 0x1e0); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/preview_panel.rs (no thumbnails yet; stays partial)
features.note: The panel model keeps items, a current index, per-item display state and visibility, with headless tests (the_preview_index_stays_inside_the_list, each_item_keeps_its_display_state_and_a_new_list_resets_them, the_data_source_fills_at_most_the_item_cap, the_panel_shows_and_hides_through_the_shell_and_an_empty_panel_stays_hidden). The shell decodes the message but does not draw the panel yet, so no thumbnail is shown through it.

Wave 2 (theme-35, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. A failed render returns None. No error domain or codes.

gaps: No QLThumbnailProvider extension point for custom file types
No system-wide thumbnail display in Files, Spotlight or the search panel
No thumbnail generator for PDF, text, audio, video or Live Photo files; only the Photos app decodes images
No representation types (icon, low quality, thumbnail) and no update or completion handlers
